programs.title: Hard Luck
programs.desc: A former criminal (Wesley Snipes) goes on the run with a stripper (Jacquelyn Quinones) after a drug deal goes bad.

programs.title: Suspect
programs.desc: Carl Anderson (Liam Neeson), a deaf, mute and homeless war veteran, is arrested for the murder of a prominent judge's secretary. But Kathleen Riley (Cher), Anderson's lawyer, believes her client is innocent. She sets out to track down the real killer, and, as the trial proceeds, makes an unlikely ally in Eddie Sanger (Dennis Quaid), a jury member. When they aren't in court, the two investigate the case and manage to uncover a massive conspiracy.

programs.title: Elektra Luxx
programs.desc: A favor for a woman from her past throws the life of a pregnant, retired porn star (Carla Gugino) into chaos.

programs.title: The Hunt for Eagle One
programs.desc: A lieutenant (Mark Dacascos) leads his men in a daring mission to rescue a captain (Theresa Randle) who is trapped behind enemy lines.

programs.title: Relentless
programs.desc: Los Angeles police detectives (Robert Loggia, Leo Rossi) track the so-called Sunset Killer (Judd Nelson), who taunts them with messages.

programs.title: Fathers and Sons
programs.desc: ESP and danger bond a beach-town intellectual (Jeff Goldblum) and his son (Rory Cochrane) despite their clashing friends and lives.

programs.title: Clive Barker's The Plague
programs.desc: Left comatose for 10 years, teenagers awaken to possess strange powers and a thirst for blood.

programs.title: The 6th Day
programs.desc: A world of the very near future in which cattle, fish and even family pet can be cloned. But cloning humans is illegal -- that is until family man Adam Gibson comes home from work one day to find a clone has replaced him. Taken from his family and plunged into a sinister world he doesn't understand, Gibson must not only save himself from the assassins who must now destroy him to protect their secret, but uncover who and what is behind the horrible things happening to him.

programs.title: Deadly Illusion
programs.desc: A private eye (Billy Dee Williams) hired to kill a man's wife (Morgan Fairchild) warns her instead and then finds both are impostors.

programs.title: Murder at the Presidio
programs.desc: A military investigator (Lou Diamond Phillips) goes beyond the call of duty to find out who killed the wife of a highly regarded Marine.

programs.title: The Informers
programs.desc: In the 1980s Los Angeles, a group of self-absorbed hedonists drift through their lives without the benefit of a moral compass. A movie executive (Billy Bob Thornton) carries on an affair with a newscaster, while his son (Jon Foster) tries to sort out his relationship with his promiscuous girlfriend (Amber Heard). Meanwhile, a sleazy ex-con (Mickey Rourke) hatches a plan to sell a kidnapped child for some quick cash.

programs.title: American Crude
programs.desc: A man (Ron Livingston) meets a prostitute, an ex-convict and a porn king when he throws a bachelor party for his best friend (Rob Schneider).
